horoscopes.horoscope: Today even if you are alone, you may not really feel lonely. You will desire to listen to your inner self, so that you can express yourself more imaginatively. Ganesha says spend the evening with your beloved who can listen to your voice in your silence also. Your partner will be very happy to see you in the mood to abdicate. You may like to discuss something eventful today. However, you should not engage in any activity without discussing with your partner. The decision should be made in a joint effort, says Ganesha. You may be upset with whatever is happening around you. This may cause negative thinking and you may feel sad about it. You need to remain objective about things. That is the best way in which you can pass the day smoothly, says Ganesha. Stay tuned with the market and see if you can earn well in the near future by changing your job or by getting more business or by other sources. Pending dues will be bothering you. Sometimes you need to keep aside your desires in order to fulfill the desires of people close to you. Though you may want to do something unusual in the workplace, you may have to settle for routine matters. It’s better if you bring some innovative methods to accomplish the routine projects.

Your romantic relationship will be working on an overdrive today, says Ganesha. You will discover answers to the finer aspects of your love life. Overall, you will have a refreshingly creative outlook all through the day. It is a favourable day for those who cherish unrequited love, says Ganesha. You tend to influence your partner through your sweet talks. You may plan to take advantage of the commanding position in the relationship. However, you should not be possessive in love, says Ganesha. This is the time to maintain a healthy relationship to sparkle romance. The day is going to be good for your health. However, you will not be in a mood to work for long hours at office, says Ganesha. You can well start doing regular exercise and increase your energy level and resistance power. Today you should spend money on friends to make them feel happy and to make yourself feel happy. Give them a treat, throw a party. Ganesha promises that you will get big returns in the future. Today, your success will be guaranteed as it may be achieved through minimal efforts. You should not go for the short-cuts. The materialistic world allures you today. Your focus will shift from your prime responsibility to unworthy things, feels Ganesha.

Today, you are likely to rack your brains to get things done. But your modesty will not do you any good. You will have to show that you are the boss, even if you are not. Your extraordinary brilliance will translate into exceptional performance and will save the day. Never forget that your family is the foundation of your success, says Ganesha. You may feel very emotional today and thus hope to be with that special someone as soon as work is over. You might get engaged in the fun-filled activities. Watching a comedy film or singing with your sweetheart will be in your mind, foresees Ganesha. You may lack clarity while dealing with various situations in personal and professional life. This could lead you to stressful mental condition. You need to simplify things in order to find all the right answers. Ganesha advises you to enjoy each moment of life. You will be over-thinking about matters which will be confusing you more and more. You should a well-wishers’ advise on your work-related matters today as they are linked directly with your finances. The day supports work like data collection, data entry and communicating with clients and your seniors in the office. Though you may find yourself puzzled over a few matters, strategic thinking will help you find a way. Prioritising and scheduling your daily activities will give you a relief.

Today, you may focus your entire attention on your relationships – your ties with your parents, spouse, children, siblings and even neighbours. However, all that effort and energy may not get its due, and you may get a cold response from one or more of your relatives. Still there is no reason to lose heart. Ganesha feels that they will come around some other day. Ganesha finds you having a quality time with your soul-mate and trying to express your love for him/her in quite a dramatic fashion. You may engage your partner in cooking and tend to indulge in fun-filled romantic activities. Your beloved will feel good with you. You will want to do something new. It’s a good day to do something that gives you a sense of satisfaction. As you are sensitive, if your sensitivity is affected, your health may also get affected. You should try to remain emotionally composed today. This is going to be a good day for you so you should not waste any money. Whatever you do, can translate into money quickly. Trust Ganesha’s words, this is going to be highly favourable day for you. You will excel in the creative tasks as your instincts will guide you today. You may want to apply your creative ideas, no matter which department you are in. However, you may be a good listener today which helps in understanding a smooth workflow.

The bourgeoisie feasted on cake, while the masses starved for want of a mere loaf of bread. Ganesha foresees something similar for you today, as you show the propensity to indulge in unwanted expenses. Whether it is impulsive decisions or compulsive buying, they shall not serve as an excuse on a later date when the milk is already spilt. Remember the fable of the Grasshopper and the Ant? Learn to exercise restraint. Fortunately, the evening will be stress-free and joyful in the presence of your sweetheart who will not just make you feel good but also let you engage in some amazing discussion that will enhance your knowledge. You may gain inspiration from your spouse. Your health may not be good today. Ganesha feels that because of ill health you should avoid tasks that can demand more physical hard work. Just stay calm and keep doing mechanical jobs or jobs that are not much tiring. The day looks good for disinvestment. If you are willing to do away with ancestral property, this is a good day. If you want to sell off old car that was given to you by someone, it’s a good day. You may feel an internal energy is obstructing your way. Therefore, you may not be able to complete the work you have decided. However, you never let depression take over. You will work very hard to achieve targets. You may feel irritated as your superiors may force you to complete a particular task.

You may relieve all the tension and pressure inside you today, a day which will be full of light and relaxing moments. Ganesha foretells a beneficial and progressive day for you. You will receive many invitations to social gatherings and parties. You might want to break free and enjoy yourself thoroughly with your family. A family vacation is on the cards. You may want to explore some new destination and let your loved one give an opportunity to choose from the given places. You want to spend a sensational honeymoon with your soul mate. Ganesha feels, that this seems a favorable day as your health will be fine, but try to maintain proper food timings. Try to be polite, as you’ll be dealing with a lot of people now. Your new ideas will be praised and this will uplift your morale from within. Partnership businesses are likely to flourish, says Ganesha, so if you are in one, it is time to celebrate. However, do not sideline your partner; in fact, keep him in the foreground all the time. There will be lots of work in the office and it will keep you busy throughout the day, foretells Ganesha. Though domestic affairs will keep bothering you, work will not suffer. Be a good listener today as you might have to agree to viewpoints of others.

Today, you will be in a mishmash of emotions and feelings. Also, there are chances of accumulated feelings finding an outlet. Your capacity for emotional display may take people by surprise. However, you will also enjoy the higher responsibilities reposed on you, predicts Ganesha. You have those qualities that bring your sweetheart closer to you and share some sweet moments. You may have the desire to spend some quality time with your family and Ganesha feels it will be fulfilled. This will please your soul and your loved one. Ganesha feels that it’s a good day from the health point of view. Enthusiasm and confidence level shall be low now. Try to avoid stress as it may affect your mood. It is a good day to avoid junk food and plan your daily diet properly. An imbalance in finances is something that you cannot tolerate, feels Ganesha. You will be disturbed with this. You will not know how to deal with it? Well, just make sure you spend only on bare essentials. No interesting work will come up for those dealing with the administrative sector. Those handling the technical sector will progress in their field. Wherever you work, you will get opportunities to hone new skills and discover your true potential. You will be full of enthusiasm and energy at work.

While not the Trot, you shall, however, trot on the lines of radicalism today, predicts Ganesha. Learn to think as you would, and always have, but act as others would have you to, advises Ganesha. Be the maverick that you are only with those who are closest and dearest, cautions Ganesha. Your spouse may find you demanding and possessive. It is good to express your emotions, but ensure that you don’t overdo it. You should understand your spouse really well. Your partner may expect you to discuss surprise or romantic activities before executing. Today your mind will be very sensitive. Converting your sensitivity to something creative would be a great idea. You will be able to maintain good health. As you will be doing something that satisfies you, there will be lot of sense of satisfaction. Ganesha feels that you can fill your pockets with lots of money today. Investment in speculative markets will be good for you. If you have not invested money in stocks till date, do so now. Ganesha is excited about your energetic and confident attitude. Another good thing is that failures never bother you. Plus, your creative mind will be in a mood to try out new things. You may succeed in new ventures. The projects you start today will progress rapidly.

The winds of fortune will usher in your dreams and make them come true. Be careful not to go overboard with your foresightedness, lest they be marked delusions, warns Ganesha. You must realise that the only thing permanent is change, and hence, you must overcome any disappointment with strong will and determination. Ganesha says that you can manage your emotion well but you need to be a little expressive to your partner. Your honest nature will be liked by your sweetheart but your direct and straightforward words may hurt your honey. Here, you need to work a bit, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today you will be feeling low. You may get affected by the circumstances very easily. You will take things to the heart. You should not let your emotions surface as it may happen in a wrong way. Ganesha feels that today you will spend money in decorating your personal environment. If you have your own office (business) then you should try to decorate it and make it more impressive. Energy and optimism are important parts of your nature but today the lack of energy may upset you. Ganesha feels that something unpleasant may happen at the workplace and distract you from your aim. However, you should not lose your focus on your job.

You will be overpowered with nostalgia and may long to get in touch with old pals. And as Ganesha says, chances are that you may take a liking to your ex-lover, while simultaneously strengthening your social standing. All in all, the day will be a productive one. You may wish to throw a party for a job well done. However, you may not finally go ahead with this plan because of the presence of your life partner. You may have to cancel the party and go to attend a dinner. You will feel jolly and optimistic with your spouse. Ganesha feels that today your mind will be very active. You will be able to think on various angles. Health wise, it’s not a perfect day but not a bad day too. You will be thinking more logically and you will be more calculative. Ganesha feels that today you are going to remain bit emotional about matters that are concerning your brothers and sisters. If they ask for money, you will happily lend it to them. You may have to apply your brain to various matters today. Decision making is generally a piece of cake for you, but today you may not know the appropriate direction. You may not take risk immediately. Decisions will be taken in the later part of the day.

Today, you will iron out any trouble with ease. But you may choose to play martyr and shoulder a bit of blame. That’s quite a lot to do for others, even if it is done out of compassion. You may think you are setting standards for others to follow, says Ganesha, but that may not be the case. Because of the graceful presence of Ganesha, you will get reassurance from your companion that he/she will be there with you through thick and thin. This will brighten your mood and eventually ensure a long-term relationship. However, you have to sacrifice a lot. Ganesha feels that the day is going to be good for you. No health problem is likely to occur today. Finance and family related matter may remain the cause of concern but it will not affect your health or mood. If you are over-confident about your financial standing and savings, today destiny is coming up with a litmus test. You will be at a deciding juncture where you will have to decide about major expenses. Morning time will be spent dealing with daily activities. The important tasks may come your way only in later part of the day. You will look confident and may speak directly to the senior authorities. The decisions taken today will bring good results in the future.

Major expenses are coming your way, but the good news is a lot of them can be avoided simply by drawing a line between your needs and your wants. Exercising a little restraint now will go a long way in boosting your savings later on, says Ganesha. On the relationship front, your partner will be very understanding and kind. You will be supportive and want to keep your beloved happy. A romantic relationship is on the cards. You may want to discuss some important things to take your current relationship to the next level. Ganesha says that you’ll feel like helping others and this will uplift your mood now. Try to control your sensitive feelings as it might affect your health negatively. Health looks good. But try to consume liquid diet, as it will help in the improvement of your health. Today you need to capitalize on your vast talent in the financial arena, advises Ganesha. Try to understand the market and see where you can put your talent to best use. You do possess the ability to earn more. Your attitude will undergo a change today. You will feel a special attachment to the organization you work for. The noticeable change will be the camaraderie you develop with colleagues. Ganesha foresees you lending a helping hand to anyone in need.
